claim: Footnote 29: “This then is one of the cases alluded to in footnote 20, where the grammatical apodosis doesn’t match the logical consequent”.
evidence_summary: Footnote 20 (p. 723) concerns scalar implicature: “The implicature is of the scalar type discussed in Ch. 5, §5.2.” Footnote 23 (p. 738) introduces the logical terms antecedent and consequent for protasis and apodosis, and adds “but we will see that the correspondence is not complete”.
proposed_wording: This then is one of the cases alluded to in footnote 23
inference: Does the footnote cited discuss the mismatch between apodosis and consequent?
